items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: Joe and I were very close friends

ctx.x: You told me, you had a couple of years to do dough up in Brooklyn, and you also booked Joe Turner, I see you.
Right, I booked Joe Turner for years. Joe and I were very close friends, I booked it for years.
And so did you work around here? Oh yeah, he lived here.
